Jugular Venous Pressure (JVP): Elevated, often with a prominent 'a' wave (right atrial contraction against a stiff RV) and sometimes a prominent 'v' wave (tricuspid regurgitation).
Pansystolic murmur at lower left sternal border: Tricuspid regurgitation (due to RV dilation).
Functional Valvular Regurgitation: Progressive annular dilatation causes severe functional mitral or tricuspid regurgitation, accelerating biventricular failure.
